blocks.heading: Buckram Fabric
blocks.intro: Stiff, sized fabric manufactured for shape retention in caps, belts, structured bags and other garment components that need to hold their form.

blocks.imageAlt: Buckram fabric roll used for structured garment components
blocks.heading: Fabric Built To Hold Its Shape, Not Just Its Colour
blocks.html:
Buckram is a sized or resin-treated fabric produced specifically for stiffness rather than drape. Where most interlining is chosen for how it bends, buckram is chosen for how well it resists bending — it is the material behind a cap peak that stays flat, a belt that doesn't fold under its own weight, or a box-style bag panel that keeps its edges square.

We manufacture buckram on a cotton or blended base, treated to a firm, stable hand-feel that holds up through cutting, stitching and the finished life of the garment component. Every roll is produced to a consistent stiffness so a pattern piece cut from metre 5 behaves the same as one cut from metre 500.
checklist: Manufactured in-house in Delhi, not sourced through a middleman
Consistent stiffness roll to roll for predictable cutting and stitching
Standard and custom widths available on request

blocks.heading: Buckram Variants
blocks.subtitle: Choose a stiffness grade based on how much rigidity your component needs.

items.title: Light Stiffness Grade
items.text: A softer buckram for components that need body without full rigidity — useful where some hand-flex is acceptable.

items.title: Medium Stiffness Grade
items.text: Our most commonly ordered grade, balancing firm shape-holding with workable cutting and stitching behaviour.

items.title: Heavy Stiffness Grade
items.text: Maximum rigidity for components like cap peaks and box panels that must hold a fixed profile under pressure.

items.title: Custom Width Rolls
items.text: Any of the above grades cut to a width matching your pattern layout, on confirmed bulk quantities.

blocks.heading: Buckram Fabric FAQs
blocks.intro: Don't see your question here? Ask us directly and we'll respond within one business day.

items.q: What widths does buckram come in?
items.a: We produce buckram in standard roll widths, and can cut to custom widths for confirmed bulk orders. Share your pattern width requirement and we'll confirm feasibility and lead time.

items.q: Can buckram be dyed, or is it only natural colour?
items.a: We typically supply buckram in natural, white and black, subject to availability. If you need a specific shade for a visible application, discuss it with us before finalising your order.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: Minimum quantity depends on the stiffness grade and width you need. Contact us with your requirement and we'll confirm order sizes and pricing directly.

items.q: How should buckram be stored before use?
items.a: Store rolls flat or upright in a dry area away from direct moisture. Damp storage can affect the sizing treatment and soften the stiffness before the fabric is even cut.

blocks.heading: Need Buckram In Bulk?
blocks.text: Tell us the stiffness grade, width and quantity you need — our team will respond with pricing and lead time within one business day.
